name: evaluate_interview
description: Score an AI video interview on a 0–100 scale. Reads the candidate's transcript markdown (written when the operator pastes the transcript code), pulls the role's rubric, and computes per-question + overall scores deterministically (no LLM dependency). Persists the evaluation JSON to /candidates/<id>/interview-<interview_id>-eval.json, writes score + eval_path onto the interviews row, and inserts a scorecards row with a strengths/concerns/recommendation summary so the founder's existing scorecard panel shows the result without a separate UI.
